completeness_certificate: Fix a packet o. Among its six neighbors, two are opposite exactly when they have only o as a common neighbor; non-opposite neighbor pairs have o plus one additional common neighbor. This is graph-definable.
Hence an automorphism fixing o must permute the three opposite pairs and may swap the two members inside each pair: exactly a signed channel permutation.
The image of every further packet is then forced recursively by the same opposite relation and the graph-definable commutation four-cycles, so no additional fixed-o automorphisms exist.
Precompose/postcompose by translation for an arbitrary image of o; therefore the listed semidirect product is the full carrier automorphism group.
